title: hRando for orac
excerpt: Conversion of the C&G "h rando" patch to orac. Stripped out the internal sequencer/aux key...
content:
Conversion of the C&G "h rando" patch to orac. Stripped out the internal sequencer/aux key stuff and just kept the sampler. 

https://www.critterandguitari.com/organelle-patches/h-rando

Each key has up to four wav files, can choose to cycle through them or play them randomly. ~bob filter, sample speed, decay. 

unzip into orac patches directory
Includes some random samples.

V0.2 updates: 
- Removed several unnecessary files
- Fixed sample speed - now locks near 100% to make it easier to play original speed
- Direction now adjustable with the aux button, with a handy light and indicator on the screen.
